sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
1. Fasten the chain securely at the back using the clasp.

2. Wear it solo for a clean, minimal look, or add a pendant for extra style.

3. Layer it with other chains to build your own stacked look.

4. After wear, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store in its pouch.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the S-Link Chain – 24K Gold Tone, a sleek golden chain made for everyday elegance, subtle shine and effortless styling. Its smooth, flowing S-shaped links create a clean, modern silhouette, while the soft detailing catches light gently for a refined golden glow that never feels overpowering.
Crafted on a durable base and finished in a warm 24K gold tone, the chain balances strength with all-day comfort. At just 3mm wide, it stays slim and lightweight — ideal for minimal styling or layering with other chains. The 55cm length sits comfortably at the neckline, so you can wear it on its own or pair it with a pendant for extra character.

• 
S-link design — smooth, modern and minimal texture.

• 
24K gold tone — soft shine with a premium feel.

• 
3mm width — slim, lightweight and easy to wear.

• 
55cm length — perfect for layering or solo styling.

From casual outfits to office wear and occasion looks, it blends in seamlessly and adds just the right amount of shine.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. How long is the chain?

The chain measures 55cm in length and sits comfortably at the neckline — perfect for wearing solo or layering with a pendant.

2. Is this real 24K gold?

It is a 24K gold tone finish over a durable base metal, giving you the warm golden look of gold at a fraction of the price. It is not solid gold.

3. Can both men and women wear it?

Yes. The slim, minimal S-link design is unisex and pairs easily with casual, office and occasion looks.

4. Will it fade or tarnish quickly?

With basic care it holds its shine well. Keep it away from water, perfume and sweat, wipe it with a soft dry cloth after wear and store it in its pouch.

5. Can I add a pendant to it?

Absolutely. The 55cm length and 3mm width make it an ideal base chain for your favourite pendants, or for layering with other chains.
